subject: Add human node name to log statement with node name (#1918)
reason: The change only adds the already-always-initialized human_nodename field (an sds set to sdsempty() at node creation, never NULL) to two existing LL_DEBUG log format strings in cluster_legacy.c, matching the pattern used by dozens of other log lines in the file. It alters no command replies, protocol, replication, failover, or persistence behaviour — it is a pure observability/log-text change with nothing a fuzzer oracle could observe, so no scenario is needed.
